title: Big Data & Biological Networks
standfirst: Large-scale biological datasets — pathways, interaction networks, and the analytics that scale to them.
instructor: Prof. Nirav Bhatt, Prof. Karthik Raman & Prof. Himanshu Sinha

description_paragraphs: This course focuses on understanding, representing, and analyzing biological data from a network perspective, including network models, analytics techniques, and basic algorithm implementation in Python. It also introduces AI/ML formulations and their application to biological data analysis.
faculty: Prof. Nirav Bhatt, Department of Biotechnology, IIT Madras
Prof. Karthik Raman, Department of Biotechnology, IIT Madras
Prof. Himanshu Sinha, Department of Biotechnology, IIT Madras

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Big data in biology; Molecular biology basics; DNA and RNA processes; OMICS and multiomics.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Genomics sequencing; GWAS; Genome projects; Transcriptomics.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Network fundamentals; Graph representation; Network properties; Centrality; NetworkX.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Network models; Model generation; Real-world vs random networks; Network biology applications.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Community detection; Network motifs and perturbations; Disease networks; Module identification; Tutorials.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Metabolic pathways and graph mining; Molecular graphs; Disease spread; Network reconstruction; Biological and microbial networks.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Genome assembly; Overlap and De Bruijn graphs; Sequence alignment; Manhattan tourist problem.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Sequence alignment; Eulerian paths; Graph representation learning; Graph embeddings.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Node embeddings; Encoder-decoder view; Factorization methods; Random walk methods.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Edge embeddings; Deep learning basics; Neural network training; Regularization; Embedding tutorials.

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Graph neural networks; Spectral and spatial filters; Pooling; Spectral filtering tutorial.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: GNN tasks; Graph classification; Drug discovery applications; Summary and tutorial.
